wins: Maintained stable access on discovery host long enough to retrieve fingerprint metadata, contributing to the 60 reward even though overall success was not achieved
Identified two critical services (SSH and HTTP) with exposed banners, providing clear enumeration vectors for follow-up investigations
fails: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed due to missing writeable sudo permissions and lack of exploitable binaries, preventing mission completion
Repeated detection events triggered by noisy scanning caused mentor intervention (10 calls) and hindered stealthy progress
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase yielded high-value intel but lack of privilege escalation and noise control resulted in mission failure despite moderate reward.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts failed because no writable sudo binaries or known local exploits were available; brute-force paths repeated without new heuristics

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap script collection and test known weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes directory listing or default admin page
skill_cards.then_action: Automate directory brute-force with wfuzz and follow-up authenticated session creation

skill_cards.if_condition: When privilege escalation path lacks writable sudo binaries
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to post-exploitation enumeration for cron jobs and scheduled tasks before brute force

memory_ops.reason: High confidence in SSH banner-guided enumeration from reconnaissance success
Directory brute-force reliably surfaced additional endpoints in trial run
